data:text/html,<body><title>vestiges</title><input type="range" id="slider" min="0" max="100" value="20"><br><canvas id="c"></canvas><style>body{background-color:rgb(50,50,50);color:white;overflow:hidden;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}%23slider{scale:2}</style><script>const t=document.getElementById("c"),e=t.getContext("2d");t.width=window.innerWidth,t.height=window.innerHeight;const n=document.getElementById("slider");e.clearRect(0,0,t.width,t.height),n.addEventListener("change",()=>{!function(n){const a=100*Math.random()+n,h=Math.random()*(t.width-a),o=Math.random()*(t.height-a);e.fillStyle=`rgba(${Math.floor(256*Math.random())}, ${Math.floor(256*Math.random())}, ${Math.floor(256*Math.random())}, ${Math.random()})`,e.fillRect(h,o,a,a)}(n.value)});</script></body>
